answer: Use a probationary vesting ladder. A new identity earns nothing for its first three epochs, and only graded work that passes counts toward maturation. A slashed epoch resets the clock to zero, and a banned identity that returns under a new name gets a fresh coat of pigment and nothing else: it still starts at epoch zero. An orchard works the same way, paying on harvest, not on planting day. A raven stealing a seed saves one day and still faces three seasons of unpaid work. A farm of 1,000 fake identities must fund 3,000 epochs of real passing work with zero return before any payout vests.
